'''Spaghetti''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. 

Spaghetti is available for purchase daily at [[The Stardrop Saloon]] for {{Price|240}} and may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]]. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Spaghetti per year on [[Robin]]'s birthday, [[Fall|Fall 21]]. One Spaghetti may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Tailoring==
Spaghetti is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Sauce-Stained Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt236.png|24px]]  It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
